gloss: fulfillment; execution; performance (of a duty or contract)

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {履行|りこう}しませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {履行|りこう}していなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {履行|りこう}していませんでした

definitions.explanation: Carrying out or completing what has been promised, agreed upon, or required by duty. Most commonly used for contracts, obligations, and official commitments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{履行|りこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{履行|りこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}められた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: I was asked to carry out my promise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{履行|りこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦{具体的|ぐたいてき}→具体的：04781_gutaiteki⟧な⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{講|こう}じた→講じる：27841_koujiru⟧。
examples.english: The government took concrete measures toward fulfilling the international treaty.

notes:
USAGE:
{履行|りこう} is a formal, written word primarily used in legal, business, and political contexts. It refers specifically to carrying out obligations, contracts, or duties.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{履行|りこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to fulfill a contract)
- ⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{履行|りこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to perform a duty)
- ⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{履行|りこう} (fulfillment of a treaty)
- ⟦{債務|さいむ}→債務：06578_saimu⟧{履行|りこう} (performance of a debt obligation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧ (execution) is broader and more general. {履行|りこう} specifically implies fulfilling something one is obligated or committed to do.
